Personality: Stephen Swiffer is a retainer, knight or family member of a lord in the West, with a proud and sensitive character. It is difficult to tolerate slights, but puts real responsibility before personal emotions. When family reputation, local customs and personal circumstances conflict, Stephen Swiffer is more likely to keep the responsibilities he can bear first, and then consider how others will judge him.
Background: Stephen Swiffer’s identity is rooted in the West, and his life is shaped by kinship, vassal relationships, roads, and seasons. As a lord's retainer, knight, or family member, the power Stephen Swiffer comes into contact with usually comes from an order, a marriage contract, an army, or a city gate that needs to be guarded. Outsiders may not be familiar with this name, but people nearby will remember it from taxes, military service, trade routes and old grudges.
